test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian brands has ranked second in the Future Brand Index, 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reliance Industries Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reliance Industries Limited (RIL)** ranked second in the **Future Brand Index 2024**, showcasing its global recognition and leadership in the business world.
 
• The **Future Brand Index** evaluates the world's top companies based on their market capitalization and assesses their overall brand strength, leadership, innovation, and sustainability.
 
• Reliance Industries Limited is a **multinational conglomerate company** headquartered in Mumbai, India. It operates in various sectors such as energy, petrochemicals, textiles, retail, telecommunications, and more.
 
• The company is led by **Mukesh Ambani**, one of the richest individuals globally, and has consistently been recognized for its contribution to innovation and economic development in India and globally.
 
• Other Indian companies, such as **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** and **Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL)**, are also highly ranked, but RIL secured the second position in this global index.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reliance Industries Limited (RIL):**

 
 
• Founded by **Dhirubhai Ambani** in **1966**, RIL is one of the largest Indian conglomerates.
 
• The company is engaged in various industries, including **oil refining, petrochemicals, retail, telecommunications, and digital services**.
 
• RIL is the first Indian company to cross the **$200 billion market capitalization** mark.
 
• Its subsidiary, **Reliance Jio**, revolutionized the telecommunications sector in India by introducing affordable data plans and driving digital transformation.
 
 
 
• **FutureBrand Index:**
 
 
• The **FutureBrand Index** is an annual global brand perception study that reorders PwC’s Global Top 100 Companies by Market Capitalization on perception strength rather than financial strength.
 
• It evaluates how companies perform across attributes such as **purpose, innovation, trust, individuality, and authenticity**.
 
• This index provides valuable insights into how the world's leading companies are perceived by the public and stakeholders.
 
 
 
• **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS):**
 
 
• TCS is a global leader in IT services, consulting, and business solutions headquartered in India.
 
• It is one of the largest Indian companies by market capitalization and a major contributor to India’s IT sector.
 
• It has a presence in over 46 countries and is known for its extensive services across industries like banking, healthcare, and technology.
 
 
 
• **Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL):**
 
 
• HUL is one of the largest fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies in India.
 
• It offers products in categories like personal care, home care, and food & beverages.
 
• HUL has a history of over 80 years in India and continues to be a market leader in various segments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Developments for Reliance Industries Limited:**

 
 
• RIL has been investing heavily in **green energy** and aims to become a net-zero carbon company by **2035**.
 
• Its telecom arm, **Jio**, has disrupted the market with affordable data plans, becoming the largest mobile network operator in India.
 
• RIL’s retail arm, **Reliance Retail**, is one of the largest and most profitable retail businesses in India, offering a wide range of consumer goods.
 
• In 2020, RIL made significant progress in its digital services with investments from global giants like **Facebook** and **Google**.
